sourceOnlyRuns.name: three-lesson-usability-test-planning-before-retry-budget
sourceOnlyRuns.purpose: Expose the complete local retry and outer-recovery experience under an exact three-fact source contract.
sourceOnlyRuns.finding: Repeated local and outer recovery consumed substantial time without admitting a lesson kernel. This run motivated the exact-ledger retry budget; it is not a speed baseline for the later one-lesson run.

sourceOnlyRuns.name: one-lesson-usability-evidence-basics-after-repairs
sourceOnlyRuns.purpose: Verify exact fact retention, unsafe-atom quarantine, fact-list recovery, complete compiler progress, Agent connection, and responsive export.

agent.testedQuestion: What is the second supplied fact?
agent.comparisonObservation: The preceding longer Agent turn took more than two minutes and continued into a malformed respond/tool_calls envelope after useful prose. The repaired route returned plain prose. These two questions differ, so this is interaction evidence rather than a controlled speed benchmark.

frameFindings.finding: Generated distractors introduced unsupported exclusive claims even though the early Scion preflight warned about them.
frameFindings.repair: The canonical compiler now applies the same unsupported-scope and semantic-choice checks and quarantines the item.

frameFindings.finding: When all model-authored teaching atoms were quarantined, exact instructor facts were also discarded.
frameFindings.repair: A fully matching numbered source ledger now survives as a facts-only knowledge set with an explicit review issue.

frameFindings.finding: The deterministic source-bound fallback referred to a worked example that the fact-only source did not contain.
frameFindings.repair: Fact-list-specific Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, and Create prompts use exact supplied statements, identify unsupported conclusions, and label assumptions.

frameFindings.finding: The local Agent received the full mutation-tool protocol and could emit internal JSON/function-call syntax.
frameFindings.repair: The public route now receives compact changing context plus a plain-Markdown read-only contract and a 240-token cap.

consoleBoundary.historicalDevelopmentOnlyErrors: Vite hot replacement briefly loaded useAIConfig and AIConfigProvider from different timestamped module instances while source files were changing. The error boundary recovered the workspace; this development-only transition is absent from the production build and is not presented as a production runtime failure.

claimBoundary: This is local browser evidence for the named prompts, cached pinned public base, release-candidate code, and viewports. The 441-second three-lesson run and 22-second one-lesson run have different scopes and are not a controlled speed comparison. This is not universal latency, human review, accessibility conformance, classroom validation, paid-reference parity, or adapter-win evidence.
